verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.tryardent.com that indexes Markdown versions of the docs (index.md, quickstart.md and others). The first-party ardent-cli skill also fetches the current docs so an agent can work through setup, and a dedicated AI-agents workflow page explains agent usage. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming the llms.txt in practice, and evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: With the ardent-cli skill installed, a short ask is enough — the skill fetches the current docs and works through setup
The agent runs the Ardent CLI itself — creating, using, and deleting its own branches
